style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

instructions: Translate every "en" string into Simplified Chinese (zh-Hans), game-guide register. Follow glossary.json strictly. Keep ⟦0⟧-style placeholders, numbers, units and wiki markup exactly. Return only {"items":[{"k":"...","zh":"..."}]} with the same k values.

units.en: Technically, ahistorical can slightly help if you give everyone their historical routes except ⟦0⟧, who you reset repeatedly to try to get them to go ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧ so they don't attack the ⟦3⟧ (who then in turn will not join the ⟦4⟧). However, "Historical AI focuses off with AI countries manually set to historical routes" is extremely different behavior-wise from "Historical AI focuses on". Many times, the AI will just ignore your suggestion that they do their historical route and instead do something else. So you will experience a very heavy amount of variance if you're trying this.
Create a naval queue for Convoys. Don't forget to assign the Infantry Equipment queue your MIO, since for some reason it starts unassigned.

For your first researches, get them in the following order: Electronic Mechanical Engineering, Basic Machine Tools, Early Cruiser, Concentrated Industry I, Radio, and Concentrated Industry II. Just proceed like normal with research afterwards, focusing on Computing (at least the first 2-3 techs; the rest aren't worth it), Radio, Industry, Infantry Equipment, Trucks/Trains, Artillery, and Anti-Air (in roughly that order). The reason for these researches and this order is to pump out ships as fast as possible. You need the Naval dockyard production boost from Concentrated Industry II as fast as possible in order to meet our aggressive schedule for the first invasion.

The reason for these researches and this order is to pump out ships as fast as possible. You need the ⟦0⟧ production boost from Concentrated Industry II as fast as possible in order to meet our aggressive schedule for the first invasion.

Queue up a couple ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ in Iceland on your capital; you probably won't finish them but that's fine. If you do, build ⟦2⟧. For the most part, we will be using our Civilian factories for International Market purchases anyway.
For the most part, we will be using our ⟦0⟧ for International Market purchases anyway.

With the ⟦0⟧ you gained from the first focus, start buying equipment from the Market and continue doing so for the next couple of years. You want to focus on Infantry Equipment with Towed Artillery as a second priority. You only need around 180 Towed Artillery at the most, so you can grab some trucks and trains later on if you feel you're set on guns and artillery.
You only need around 180 Towed Artillery at the most, so you can grab some trucks and trains later on if you feel you're set on guns and artillery.
Start the focus ⟦0⟧ and hire the ⟦1⟧ as Chief of Navy once you have the ⟦2⟧.
Start the focus ⟦0⟧ and hire the ⟦1⟧ as an advisor.

With your ⟦0⟧, create the most basic Early Destroyer design possible (add a Light Battery). Delete your Convoy build queue to force your 1 ⟦1⟧ to instead build this Early Destroyer. Make sure you set the build quantity to 1.

Once your Early Cruiser research finishes, do the same thing you did above (add a Light Battery and a Fire Control 0 to make the design). Add a new Naval build queue for it with the quantity set to 1.
Start the focus ⟦0⟧ and fire your Chief of Navy (click his portrait then select him again from the list). Rehire him, now as an ⟦1⟧ for Chief of Army.

Once you have 20 ⟦0⟧, alter your starting Infantry division template to replace the Cavalry Recon Detachment with Support Artillery and to remove two Infantry battalions (leaving 4 in the end). If you wish, you can also add Infantry Guns to the first regiment.

Improve relations with ⟦0⟧. While the Denmark AI seems to slightly favor letting you break away cleanly, sometimes it still takes the option for a War goal. If relations are low, it seems to be about even odds if they'll actually use this War goal on you. If you have higher relations they typically will not declare war. We really don't want them to declare war because it can mess up your Naval invasion later.

While the ⟦0⟧ AI seems to slightly favor letting you break away cleanly, sometimes it still takes the option for a War goal. If relations are low, it seems to be about even odds if they'll actually use this War goal on you. If you have higher relations they typically will not declare war. We really don't want them to declare war because it can mess up your Naval invasion later.
By this time, your Early Destroyer should be done. Your Early Cruiser is probably telling you it will finish in late 1939, but once Concentrated Industry II finishes, it will bump that timeline up.

Now that your destroyer is done, go ahead and add a single line of your starting division template to your Recruitment queue. Set the quantity to 5. We needed to wait until the destroyer was done so that the destroyer didn't stall out due to a lack of manpower to finish the construction. We'll aim to have all 5 divisions full on manpower now before the cruiser finishes, so we don't run into a conflict there either.

Once you're at least halfway through ⟦0⟧, take the Improved Worker Conditions and Anti-Communist Raids decisions.
When ⟦0⟧ finishes, set State serves the Military as your Spirit of the Army and then bump your Conscription law from ⟦1⟧ all the way up to ⟦2⟧.
From here, grab the focuses ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, and ⟦2⟧.
When you get enough ⟦0⟧, hire the ⟦1⟧ as an advisor and the ⟦2⟧ as a Theorist. Afterwards, spend your ⟦3⟧ on the Viking Spirit decisions.
Keep collecting your new divisions as they are produced and train them up to be Veterans.

For future focuses, prioritize getting your third research slot from ⟦0⟧, the free spy agency from ⟦1⟧, and then the buff from ⟦2⟧ (go down the Naval side and pick up ⟦3⟧ while you are there). As an aside, I do not recommend taking the three bottommost focuses in your political tree, ever. You get cores on islands that have no value if the others accept, and if they deny you, you get a bunch of permanent War goals that alter AI behavior. This is actually a bad thing. There's already so much randomness in this run; you don't want to introduce more.

In early November 1938, justify a War goal on the ⟦0⟧.

In January 1939, join the ⟦0⟧. Set up a Naval invasion plan from the port of Wilhelmshaven in Germany to the port one tile north of Amsterdam in the Netherlands (west of Leeuwarden). Assign your units to it so they move to Wilhelmshaven. Choosing this specific tile exploits the AI's troop positioning. The AI is deathly afraid that you will call in Germany, so nearly their entire army is going to be on the German border. Because the tile we are attacking is a port that isn't worth (Unrecognized string "Victory Points" for Template:Icon), it has a slightly lower garrison priority for the AI, and it will be completely unguarded.
Choosing this specific tile exploits the AI's troop positioning. The AI is deathly afraid that you will call in ⟦0⟧, so nearly their entire army is going to be on the German border.
Because the tile we are attacking is a port that isn't worth ⟦0⟧, it has a slightly lower garrison priority for the AI, and it will be completely unguarded.

Create a fleet with your destroyer and your cruiser (as soon as it is finished). Set them to Patrol in the Eastern North Sea while based in Wilhelmshaven. You should aim to have 150+ Naval Dominance in the Eastern North Sea before your justification finishes, so that you can launch immediately.

As the date of your justification approaches (check on the ⟦0⟧ diplomacy screen), slow down the game time. You need to declare war on the ⟦1⟧ on the exact hour that the justification finishes. Don't invite your allies or accept their requests to join. This exploits oversights in how guarantees work. While the UK guarantees the Dutch East Indies immediately when you start justifying, they don't guarantee the overlord until the day the justification finishes. This gives you a 1 hour window to declare war before the UK guarantees the Netherlands.

This exploits oversights in how guarantees work. While the ⟦0⟧ guarantees the ⟦1⟧ immediately when you start justifying, they don't guarantee the overlord until the day the justification finishes. This gives you a 1 hour window to declare war before the ⟦2⟧ guarantees the ⟦3⟧.
Launch your naval invasion. Set your fleet to Naval Invasion Support just in case.

The second your troops land (slow down the game speed again), leave 1 division on the port. Send 2 divisions to walk through Amsterdam to Utrecht. Send the other two divisions to walk through The Hague and Rotterdam to reach Breda.

If you're lucky and fast, you will capitulate the ⟦0⟧ immediately. If this does not happen, don't worry. Hold the port you came in at, The Hague, and Amsterdam (in total, 4 tiles) against the Dutch forces until June 9th, 1939. On that date, Italy joins the Axis. This changes the surrender limit, and the Netherlands should immediately capitulate. This is probably also a bug, since it doesn't make much sense for the surrender limit to be affected when the party involved hasn't even joined the war, but oh well.

If this does not happen, don't worry. Hold the port you came in at, The Hague, and Amsterdam (in total, 4 tiles) against the ⟦0⟧ forces until June 9th, 1939. On that date, ⟦1⟧ joins the ⟦2⟧. This changes the surrender limit, and the ⟦3⟧ should immediately capitulate.
This is probably also a bug, since it doesn't make much sense for the surrender limit to be affected when the party involved hasn't even joined the war, but oh well.
Annex everything from both the ⟦0⟧ and the ⟦1⟧. Take their navy too.

You should now have roughly 800k spare ⟦0⟧ and nearly 30 Factories. You may think at this point "oh wow, from here it's easy". Unfortunately, no. The easy part actually just ended. For some reason, holding the Netherlands weakens the ⟦1⟧ severely. They will likely fall before the end of 1943 due to your actions just now, which means you don't have a ton of time left.
From here, the safest choice to remain uninvolved in larger wars while growing stronger is to attack ⟦0⟧. They are the only significant neutral country that nobody will guarantee if you attack.

When ⟦0⟧ attacks ⟦1⟧, do not accept their call to arms. We're going to exploit how Naval Dominance works when a war is declared to get a naval landing in the ⟦2⟧ later, which means we can't be at war with them until the moment we invade.

Create a new division template. Use 5 ⟦0⟧ to add a single Cavalry battalion to it and save it. Then change your Garrison law to Civilian Oversight and set the Garrison template to your new Cavalry division.

As you gain more ⟦0⟧, steadily increase the combat width of your Infantry template up from 8 to 24. Add in Support Anti-Air and Engineer Company as support companies for now. You'll want to add in Recon Rangers, Field Hospitals, and Logistics Companies later as you can, but not until you're closer to being caught up on research.
Change your Economy law up to ⟦0⟧ and fill your construction queue with ⟦1⟧.
Upgrade your spy agency 5 times so you get a second spy. After this is done, begin doing Collaboration Governments on the ⟦0⟧.
Begin recruiting more divisions of your Infantry template. Aim for 20-24. Even if they aren't fully equipped, that's fine.
When you finish the focus ⟦0⟧, you will want to start routinely taking the decisions to "Refit ships to Destroyers" and "Refit ships to Cruisers".

You can do an exploit here as well to increase the power of your Navy substantially if you want, but it doesn't make a huge difference. In case you do though: Create an Early Cruiser named "Refitted Cruiser Class". Fill all the module slots out with the most expensive options. For the slots with many choices, I recommend picking the Heavy Cruiser Battery I every time. This will make a Heavy Cruiser design that's basically just a floating fortress of guns and armor, which is incredible when you're getting it for free. Save the design; it doesn't matter if a number is appended or anything, as long as the actual name field is correct before the decision finishes. Repeat the above process for an Early Destroyer as well, naming it "Refitted Destroyer Class". For the Destroyer, just fill out the optional modules with whatever you wish (I went with Torpedoes). It should cost 30 Navy experience to save. If you're short on Navy experience for either design, set your entire Navy to train. It gets you 0.3 Navy experience per day based on the percentage of your Navy currently training. Spam these decisions for the rest of the game to make your Navy steadily stronger over time.
